spec: docs/milestones/M11-stage2.md §2, §7.4 (the format of this file) and §8
howToRead: shows: one Show per skill. `template` is the hands-on template the Show plays on and `scene` is its scene in pack form. `steps` are the moves in order, `by` host or child; the last step is always the child's (`handOver: last`). The key line plays at the step marked `say: key`. Other step keys (trace, count, sticks, walk, push, stack, turn, stamp) name the motion of the host hand; `picture` describes it for the design-director.

lines: at most three host lines, roles open, key (the reminder replays it, at most 8 seconds) and handover; every line is at most 6 words, because the host bubble on the phone holds two lines at the band's size (docs/design/m11-rooms.md 13.6). `text` is the final pointed text for the screen and `voice` the voice text for the voice inventory (hebrew-text-editor, 2026-11-15, text-ready: waits for the owner's approval). Until the owner voices them each shows as a bubble with a pause.
teaches: the words the Show says, as the items label them (rule W1 compares the option labels of the skill's scored items with them).

lessons: every Shape Forest lesson in parts. `recall` lists candidate ids of the prerequisite skill (served only once that skill was started); `together` reuses a pool item with `lead`, the number of steps the host does first; `alone` is the pool, rung 0 first; `use` is the check that ends the lesson. The stage caps (`caps`, spec §2.5) decide how much of the pool one visit serves.
hostLines: Kubi's lines that belong to no one skill: the Together lead-in per template, the hand-over to the companion when Alone starts, and the replies of the "show me" hand.
